items.title: Claude Code 2.1.328 → 2.1.328
items.snippet:
2.1.328
- Added auto mode for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and Claude apps gateway; interactive sessions with no permission mode start in it
- Added `"onFailure": "block"` for `mcp_tool` hooks, as for command and HTTP hooks: a hook whose call fails blocks the action
- Added a warning when a message from a session that skips permission prompts may be held and dropped by a cloud session
- Added a notice in `/status` and `claude doctor` when an OpenTelemetry exporter has no endpoint and its data would likely be lost
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_DEFERRED_TOOL_RESUME`, which lets a host stop `claude -p --resume` and `--continue` from running a tool call that a hook deferred
- Added support for apps that embed Claude Code to switch on the policy plugin's `allowManagedModsOnly` option; an admin's managed settings still win
- Added a startup warning to the Claude apps gateway when a policy's `maxEffortLevel` is not a valid effort level
- Self-hosted runner: Added `--repository-folder` to name the folder that sessions use for a repository at `--capacity 1`, in place of its path under the base folder, which can't be a symbolic link

items.title: Page changed: Models overview (API ids, prices)
Page changed: Model deprecations
added: Claude Code uses the Claude API, including when you sign in with a Claude plan, so this page’s dates apply. If Claude Code is set up for another platform or for a gateway, the dates are those of the platform that serves its requests.
Once a model is deprecated, migrate all usage to a suitable replacement before the retirement date. Once the model is retired, requests to it fail.
This retirement includes claude-sonnet-4-5 , the same model’s ID without a date.

If you use Claude Code, see Overview for which dates apply and Migrating to replacements for what to change. Once this model is retired, Claude Code on the Claude API shows an error that begins There's an issue with the selected model . If you set a fallback model chain , Claude Code switches to the next model in the chain instead. It tries Claude Sonnet 4.5 again on your next message.
removed: Once a model is deprecated, migrate all usage to a suitable replacement before the retirement date. Requests to models past the retirement date will fail.
